### 1000-times 8:2 sample split (Lasso + split-validation C-index), combine with 435 Sample lasso results KM

##### 435s, 8:2 sample split lasso, for cindex calculation
###### functions for 8:2 sample split (Lasso + split-validation C-index) 
```{r}
cindex_28_fun_os <- function(seed = 1234, tab_4_cox_28 = tab_4_os_sig_cox, test_list = test_os, cox_res_sig = os_sig_features_names){
  res <- tryCatch({
    set.seed(seed)
    train_idx <- sort(sample(c(1:nrow(tab_4_cox_28)),  size = round(nrow(tab_4_cox_28)*0.8)))
    test_idx <- setdiff(c(1:nrow(tab_4_cox_28)), train_idx)
    
    cox_fit_list <- lapply(1:length(test_list), function(i){
      
      set.seed(seed)
      cv.fit_ <- cv.glmnet(x = as.matrix(tab_4_cox_28[ train_idx, cox_res_sig$factor[cox_res_sig$omics %in% test_list[[i]]] ]),
                           y = tab_4_cox_28[train_idx, ]$sur_os,
                           family="cox", parallel = T, alpha=1)
      fit_ <- glmnet(x = as.matrix(tab_4_cox_28[ train_idx, cox_res_sig$factor[cox_res_sig$omics %in% test_list[[i]]] ]),
                     y = tab_4_cox_28[train_idx, ]$sur_os,
                     family="cox", alpha=1)
      s_ <- cv.fit_$lambda.min
      lasso_factor <- names(coef(fit_)[,fit_[["lambda"]] == s_] [coef(fit_)[,fit_[["lambda"]] == s_]!=0 ])
      rm(cv.fit_, fit_, s_)
      
      formula = as.formula(paste("sur_os", " ~ ", paste(lasso_factor, collapse = "+") ))
      
      cox_model <- survival::coxph(formula,data = tab_4_cox_28[train_idx, ])
      list(
        model = cox_model,
        factors = lasso_factor
      )
    })
    
    names(cox_fit_list) <- sapply(test_list, function(i){paste(i, collapse = "+")})
    
    cindx_tab1 <- data.frame(model = names(cox_fit_list),
                             cindex = sapply(cox_fit_list, function(x){
                               survival::concordance(x$model, newdata = tab_4_cox_28[test_idx, ])[[1]]}),
                             seed = seed,
                            factors = sapply(cox_fit_list, function(x){
                              paste(x$factors, collapse = ";")
                            }))
    cindx_tab1
  }, error = function(e){
    cindx_tab1 <- data.frame(model = c(sapply(test_list, function(i){paste(i, collapse = "+")})),cindex = NA,seed = seed,factors=NA)
    cindx_tab1
    message("error messages: ", e$message)
  })
  
  res
  
}

cindex_28_fun_dfs <- function(seed = 1234, tab_4_cox_28 = tab_4_dfs_sig_cox, test_list = test_dfs, cox_res_sig = dfs_sig_features_names){
  res <- tryCatch({
    set.seed(seed)
    train_idx <- sort(sample(c(1:nrow(tab_4_cox_28)),  size = round(nrow(tab_4_cox_28)*0.8)))
    test_idx <- setdiff(c(1:nrow(tab_4_cox_28)), train_idx)
  
    cox_fit_list <- lapply(1:length(test_list), function(i){
      if(i == 1){                        
        cox_model <- survival::coxph(as.formula(paste("sur_dfs", " ~ ", "TNM_Stage" )),
                        data = tab_4_cox_28[train_idx, ])
        list(
            model = cox_model,
            factors = "TNM_Stage"
          )
        
      } else {
        set.seed(seed)
        cv.fit_ <- cv.glmnet(x = as.matrix(tab_4_cox_28[ train_idx, cox_res_sig$factor[cox_res_sig$omics %in% test_list[[i]]] ]),
                             y = tab_4_cox_28[train_idx, ]$sur_dfs,
                             family="cox", parallel = T, alpha=1)
        fit_ <- glmnet(x = as.matrix(tab_4_cox_28[ train_idx, cox_res_sig$factor[cox_res_sig$omics %in% test_list[[i]]] ]),
                       y = tab_4_cox_28[train_idx, ]$sur_dfs,
                       family="cox", alpha=1)
        s_ <- cv.fit_$lambda.min
        lasso_factor <- names(coef(fit_)[,fit_[["lambda"]] == s_] [coef(fit_)[,fit_[["lambda"]] == s_]!=0 ])
        rm(cv.fit_, fit_, s_)
        
        cox_model <- survival::coxph(as.formula(paste("sur_dfs", " ~ ", paste(lasso_factor, collapse = " + ") )),
                        data = tab_4_cox_28[train_idx, ])
        list(
            model = cox_model,
            factors = lasso_factor
          )
      }
    })
    names(cox_fit_list) <- c(sapply(test_list, function(i){paste(i, collapse = "+")}))
    
    cindx_tab1 <- data.frame(model = names(cox_fit_list),
                             cindex = sapply(cox_fit_list, function(x){
                          survival::concordance(x$model, newdata = tab_4_cox_28[test_idx, ])[[1]]}),
                             seed = seed,
                            factors = sapply(cox_fit_list, function(x){
                              paste(x$factors, collapse = ";")
                            }))
    
    cindx_tab1
  }, error = function(e){
    cindx_tab1 <- data.frame(model = c(sapply(test_list, function(i){paste(i, collapse = "+")})),
                             cindex = NA,
                             seed = seed,
                             factor=NA)
    cindx_tab1
    message("error messages: ", e$message)
  })
  
  res
  
}

```

###### runing 1000 times 8:2 sample split (Lasso + split-validation C-index) 
```{r}

load(file = "model_features.20250612.RData")
rownames(tab_4_dfs_sig_cox) <- tab_4_dfs_sig_cox$Sample
rownames(tab_4_os_sig_cox) <- tab_4_os_sig_cox$Sample

os_all_feature_types <- sort(unique(os_sig_features_names$omics))
test_os <- c(combn(os_all_feature_types, m = 1, simplify = FALSE), 
              combn(os_all_feature_types, m = 2, simplify = FALSE),
              combn(os_all_feature_types, m = 3, simplify = FALSE),
              combn(os_all_feature_types, m = 4, simplify = FALSE))

dfs_all_feature_types <- sort(unique(dfs_sig_features_names$omics))
test_dfs <- c(combn(dfs_all_feature_types, m = 1, simplify = FALSE), 
              combn(dfs_all_feature_types, m = 2, simplify = FALSE),
              combn(dfs_all_feature_types, m = 3, simplify = FALSE),
              combn(dfs_all_feature_types, m = 4, simplify = FALSE),
              combn(dfs_all_feature_types, m = 5, simplify = FALSE))

cindex_28_1000res_os <- do.call(rbind, lapply(1:1000, function(ii){cindex_28_fun_os(seed = ii)}))

cindex_28_1000res_dfs <- do.call(rbind, lapply(1:1000, function(ii){cindex_28_fun_dfs(seed = ii)}))

write_tsv(cindex_28_1000res_dfs, file = "cindex_dfs_20251030.tsv")
write_tsv(cindex_28_1000res_os, file = "cindex_os_20251030.tsv")
```

```{r}
  } else {
    combn_features
  }
  
  })
```

###### prognostic models
```{r}
load(file="dfs.all_combn.lasso.RData")
load(file="os.all_combn.lasso.RData")
load(file = "model_features.20250612.RData")

prognosis_model_fun <- function(seed = 1234, sur_model="",features_combn = c(), input_df=data.frame()){
  
  ############## cox results for all features
  cox_fit_list <- do.call(list, Map(function(i,name){
    print(name)

    set.seed(seed)
    input_df_tmp <- input_df[,c("Sample",i,sur_model)]
    input_df_tmp <- input_df_tmp[complete.cases(input_df_tmp),]
    total_samples <- nrow(input_df_tmp)
    ############# cox results 
    cox_results <- survival::coxph(as.formula(paste(sur_model, " ~ ", paste(i, collapse = " + ") )),data = input_df_tmp)
    c_index <- survival::concordance(cox_results)$concordance
    
    ############# tab_coef
    tab_coef_multi <- as.data.frame(summary(cox_results)[[7]]) %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(features = rownames(as.data.frame(summary(cox_results)[[7]]))) %>% 
      dplyr::arrange(desc(coef)) 

    tab_risk_cox <- data.frame(input_df_tmp[, c("Sample", sur_model)],
                               cox_rs = predict(cox_results, type = "risk", newdata = input_df_tmp[, i,drop=FALSE])) %>%
      left_join(chemo_dat[, c("Sample", "chemotherapy")], by = "Sample") %>% 
      left_join(input_df[, c("Sample", "TNM_Stage")], by = "Sample")

    ############# features importance
    wald_tab <- as.data.frame(summary(cox_results)[[7]]) %>% 
      dplyr::filter(is.na(z) == F) %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(abs_wald = abs(z))
    wald_tab <- wald_tab %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(factor_name = rownames(wald_tab)) %>% 
      dplyr::select("factor_name", "abs_wald") %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(prop_wald = (`abs_wald`/sum(wald_tab$`abs_wald`))*100) %>% 
      dplyr::arrange(`prop_wald`)
      
    ############# return results
    cindx_tab <- list(
      model = name,  # 特征组合名称
      c_index = c_index,          # C-index
      # cox_results = cox_results,
      tab_coef_multi = tab_coef_multi,
      tab_risk_cox = tab_risk_cox,
      wald_tab = wald_tab,
      features = paste(i, collapse = ", "),
      sample_num = total_samples,
      seed=seed
    )
  
    cindx_tab
    
  },features_combn, names(features_combn))
  )
  cox_fit_list
  
}

## call functions with one seed
prog_model_dfs <- prognosis_model_fun(seed = 1234, sur_model="sur_dfs", features_combn=dfs_lasso_results_list, input_df=tab_4_dfs_sig_cox)

prog_model_os <- prognosis_model_fun(seed = 1234, sur_model="sur_os", features_combn=os_lasso_results_list, input_df=tab_4_os_sig_cox)

save(prog_model_dfs,prognosis_model_fun, file="prog_model_dfs.Rdata")
save(prog_model_os, file="prog_model_os.Rdata")
```

###### chemotherapy KM plots functions
```{r}
plot_km_fun <- function(tab_4_kmplot, title = "", model_name, name, dirname,suffix){
  
  if (!dir.exists(dirname)) {
    dir.create(dirname, recursive = TRUE)
  }
   risk_group <- tab_4_kmplot %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.na(tab_4_kmplot[,model_name]) == F) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.na(`cox_rs`) == F) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(risk_group = factor(ifelse(`cox_rs` <= median(`cox_rs`), "Low Risk", "High Risk"), levels = c("Low Risk", "High Risk"))) 
   
  ### High risk
  high_risk <- risk_group %>%
    dplyr::filter(risk_group == "High Risk") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(labs = factor(chemotherapy, levels = c("Non-Chemotherapy", "Chemotherapy"))) %>%
    dplyr::rename(sur = !!sym(model_name)) 
  
  cox_formula <- as.formula("sur ~ labs")
  cox_model <- coxph(cox_formula, data=high_risk)
  cox_res <- summary(cox_model)
  HR <- signif(cox_res$coefficients[1,"exp(coef)"],digits=2)
  HR_lower95 <- signif(cox_res$conf.int[1,"lower .95"],digits=2)
  HR_upper95 <- signif(cox_res$conf.int[1,"upper .95"],digits=2)
  HR_str_high_risk <- paste0("HR = ",HR, " (",HR_lower95," - ",HR_upper95,")")
    
  km_fit_high_risk <- survfit(sur ~ labs, data = high_risk)
  p_val_high_risk <- survminer::surv_pvalue(km_fit_high_risk,data=high_risk)$pval
  formatted_p_high_risk <- sprintf("%.5g", p_val_high_risk)  
  formatted_p_high_risk <- paste0("P = ", formatted_p_high_risk)
  
  ### low risk
  low_risk <- risk_group %>%
    dplyr::filter(risk_group == "Low Risk") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(labs = factor(chemotherapy, levels = c("Non-Chemotherapy", "Chemotherapy"))) %>%
    dplyr::rename(sur = !!sym(model_name)) 
  
  cox_formula <- as.formula("sur ~ labs")
  cox_model <- coxph(cox_formula, data=low_risk)
  cox_res <- summary(cox_model)
  HR <- signif(cox_res$coefficients[1,"exp(coef)"],digits=2)
  HR_lower95 <- signif(cox_res$conf.int[1,"lower .95"],digits=2)
  HR_upper95 <- signif(cox_res$conf.int[1,"upper .95"],digits=2)
  HR_str_low_risk <- paste0("HR = ",HR, " (",HR_lower95," - ",HR_upper95,")")
  
  km_fit_low_risk <- survfit(sur ~ labs, data = low_risk)
  p_val_low_risk <- survminer::surv_pvalue(km_fit_low_risk,data=low_risk)$pval
  formatted_p_low_risk <- sprintf("%.5g", p_val_low_risk)  
  formatted_p_low_risk <- paste0("P = ", formatted_p_low_risk)
  
  ### counts of patients
  high_risk_counts <- table(high_risk$labs)
  high_risk_che_count <- high_risk_counts["Chemotherapy"][[1]]
  high_risk_nonche_count <- high_risk_counts["Non-Chemotherapy"][[1]]
  
  low_risk_counts <- table(low_risk$labs)
  low_risk_che_count <- low_risk_counts["Chemotherapy"]
  low_risk_nonche_count <- low_risk_counts["Non-Chemotherapy"]
  
  if (model_name=="sur_dfs") {
    ylabel = "DFS"
  } else if(model_name=="sur_os"){
    ylabel = "OS"
  }
  
  p1 <- ggsurvplot(km_fit_high_risk, 
           data = high_risk,
           pval = FALSE,     
           risk.table = FALSE,    # 添加风险表
           conf.int = FALSE,      # 显示置信区间
           palette = c("#E41A1C","#377EB8" ), 
           title = paste0(suffix," (High-risk)"),
           tables.y.text = FALSE,
           xlab = "Time (Months)", 
           ylab = ylabel,
           legend = c(0.38,0.35),
           legend.title = "",
           legend.labs=c(paste0("Non-Chemotherapy (n=", high_risk_nonche_count,")"),
                         paste0("Chemotherapy (n=", high_risk_che_count, ")"))
           ) 
        high_risk_nonche_count,")"), size = 5, hjust = 0) 
  plot1 <- p1$plot + annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0.15, label = formatted_p_high_risk, size = 5, hjust = 0)
  plot1 <- plot1 + annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0.05, label = HR_str_high_risk, size = 5, hjust = 0)
  
  
  p2 <- ggsurvplot(km_fit_low_risk, 
           data = low_risk,
           pval = FALSE,     
           risk.table = FALSE,    # 添加风险表
           conf.int = FALSE,      # 显示置信区间
           palette = c( "#E41A1C","#377EB8"), 
           title = paste0(suffix," (Low-risk)"),
           tables.y.text = FALSE,
           xlab = "Time (Months)", 
           ylab = ylabel,
           legend = c(0.38,0.35),
           legend.title = "",
           legend.labs=c(paste0("Non-Chemotherapy (n=", low_risk_nonche_count,")"),
                         paste0("Chemotherapy (n=", low_risk_che_count, ")")
                         )
           )
  plot2 <- p2$plot + annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0.15, label = formatted_p_low_risk, size = 5, hjust = 0)
  plot2 <- plot2 + annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0.05, label = HR_str_low_risk, size = 5, hjust = 0)
  
  
  file_name = paste0(dirname, model_name,".",gsub("\\s*\\+\\s*", "_", name),".",suffix, ".chemo_KM_plot.pdf" )

  combined_plot <- plot_grid(plot1, plot2, ncol = 2)
  
  ggsave(combined_plot, file=file_name,device="pdf", width=8, height=4)
  output_file <- paste0(dirname, model_name,".","chemo_KM_results.", suffix, ".tsv")
  
  if (!file.exists(output_file)) {
    write.table(
      data.frame(
        model = character(),
        p_val_high_risk = character(),
        p_val_low_risk = character()
      ),
      file = output_file,
      sep = "\t",
      row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = TRUE,
      quote = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  write.table(
    data.frame(
      model = name,
      p_val_high_risk = p_val_high_risk,
      p_val_low_risk = p_val_low_risk
    ),
    file = output_file,
    sep = "\t",
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = FALSE,
    quote = FALSE,
    append = TRUE
  )
}

save(plot_km_fun, file = "chemo_KM_plot.functions.template.Rdata")
```

###### KM plots functions
```{r}
plot_km_fun <- function(tab_4_kmplot, title = "", model_name, name, dirname, suffix){
  if (!dir.exists(dirname)) {
    dir.create(dirname, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  aa <- tab_4_kmplot %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.na(tab_4_kmplot[,model_name]) == F) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.na(`cox_rs`) == F) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(labs = factor(ifelse(`cox_rs` <= median(`cox_rs`), "Low Risk", "High Risk"), levels = c("Low Risk", "High Risk"))) %>%
    dplyr::rename(sur = !!sym(model_name)) 
  
  cox_formula <- as.formula("sur ~ labs")
  cox_model <- coxph(cox_formula, data=aa)
  cox_res <- summary(cox_model)
  HR <- cox_res$coefficients[1,"exp(coef)"]
  HR_lower95 <- cox_res$conf.int[1,"lower .95"]
  HR_upper95 <- cox_res$conf.int[1,"upper .95"]
  HR_str <- paste0(HR,"= (",HR_lower95," - ",HR_upper95,")")
    
  km_fit <- survfit(sur ~ labs, data = aa)
  p_val <- survminer::surv_pvalue(km_fit,data=aa)$pval
  formatted_p <- sprintf("%.5g", p_val)
  formatted_p <- paste0("P = ", formatted_p)

  risk_counts <- table(aa$labs)
  low_risk_count <- risk_counts["Low Risk"]
  high_risk_count <- risk_counts["High Risk"]
  
  if (model_name=="sur_dfs") {
    ylabel = "DFS"
  } else if(model_name=="sur_os"){
    ylabel = "OS"
  }
  
  p1 <- ggsurvplot(km_fit, 
           data = aa,
           pval = FALSE,     
           risk.table = TRUE,    # 添加风险表
           conf.int = FALSE,      # 显示置信区间
           palette = c("#377EB8", "#E41A1C"), 
           title = title,
           tables.y.text = FALSE,
           xlab = "Time (Months)", 
           ylab = ylabel,
           ggtheme = theme_classic() + theme(
             plot.title = element_text(size=8)
           ),
           legend = c(0.38,0.35),
           legend.title = "",
           legend.labs=c(paste0("Low-risk (n = ",low_risk_count, ")"),
                         paste0("High-risk (n=", high_risk_count,")"))
           ) 

  plot <- p1$plot + annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0.1, label = formatted_p, size = 5, hjust = 0)
  
  return(list(plot=plot, p_val=p_val, risk_group=aa))
}

save(plot_km_fun, file = "KM_plot.functions.template.Rdata")

### all patients
KM_plot_fuc_stage_all <- function(model_list, name, model_name,dirname,suffix) {
  print(name)
  tryCatch({
    tab_risk_cox_tmp <- model_list$tab_risk_cox
    
    result <- plot_km_fun(tab_4_kmplot = tab_risk_cox_tmp, title = paste0(name," ",suffix), model_name = model_name, name=name,dirname=dirname,suffix=suffix)
    
    ### high-low risk sample groups
    high_risk_group <- result$risk_group %>%
      filter(labs=="High Risk")
    high_risk_group_samples <- paste(high_risk_group$Sample, collapse=",")
    low_risk_group <- result$risk_group %>%
      filter(labs=="Low Risk")
    low_risk_group_samples <- paste(low_risk_group$Sample, collapse=",")
  
    file_name = paste0(dirname,model_name,".",gsub("\\s*\\+\\s*", "_", name),".",suffix, ".KM_plot.pdf" )
    ggsave(result$plot, file=file_name,device="pdf", width=4, height=4)
    
    output_file <- paste0(dirname, model_name,".","KM_results.", suffix, ".tsv")
    if (!file.exists(output_file)) {
      write.table(
        data.frame(
          model = character(),
          p_val = character(),
          high_risk_samples = character(),
          low_risk_samples = character()
        ),
        file = output_file,
        sep = "\t",
        row.names = FALSE,
        col.names = TRUE,
        quote = FALSE
      )
    }
    
    write.table(
      data.frame(
        model = name,
        p_val = result$p_val,
        high_risk_samples = high_risk_group_samples,
        low_risk_samples = low_risk_group_samples
      ),
      file = output_file,sep = "\t",row.names = FALSE,col.names = FALSE,quote = FALSE,append = TRUE)
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Error:", e$message))
  })
}

### stages
KM_plot_fuc_stage_split <- function(model_list, name, model_name,dirname,suffix="") {
  print(name)
  output_df <- data.frame()
  ###### stage 1
  tryCatch({
  tab_risk_cox_tmp <- model_list$tab_risk_cox %>%
    dplyr::filter(`TNM_Stage` %in% c(0/3))
  result1 <- plot_km_fun(tab_4_kmplot = tab_risk_cox_tmp, title = paste0(name," Stage-I"), model_name = model_name, name=name,dirname=dirname,suffix="Stage-I")
  output_df[name, "Stage-I_KM_pvalue"] = result1$p_val
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Error in Stage-I:", e$message))
  })
  
  ###### stage 2
  tryCatch({
  tab_risk_cox_tmp <- model_list$tab_risk_cox %>%
    dplyr::filter(`TNM_Stage` %in% c(1/3))
  result2 <- plot_km_fun(tab_4_kmplot = tab_risk_cox_tmp, title = paste0(name," Stage-II"), model_name = model_name, name=name,dirname=dirname,suffix="Stage-II")
  output_df[name, "Stage-II_KM_pvalue"] = result2$p_val
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Error in Stage-II:", e$message))
  })
  
  ###### stage 3
  tryCatch({
  tab_risk_cox_tmp <- model_list$tab_risk_cox %>%
    dplyr::filter(`TNM_Stage` %in% c(2/3))
  result3 <- plot_km_fun(tab_4_kmplot = tab_risk_cox_tmp, title = paste0(name," Stage-III"), model_name = model_name, name=name,dirname=dirname,suffix="Stage-III")
  output_df[name, "Stage-III_KM_pvalue"] = result3$p_val
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Error in Stage-III:", e$message))
  })
  
  ###### stage 4
  tryCatch({
  tab_risk_cox_tmp <- model_list$tab_risk_cox %>%
    dplyr::filter(`TNM_Stage` %in% c(3/3))
  result4 <- plot_km_fun(tab_4_kmplot = tab_risk_cox_tmp, title = paste0(name," Stage-IV"), model_name = model_name, name=name, dirname=dirname,suffix="Stage-IV")
  output_df[name, "Stage-IV_KM_pvalue"] = result4$p_val
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Error in Stage-IV:", e$message))
  })
  
  tryCatch({
    ### combine plots
    file_name = paste0(dirname,model_name,".",gsub("\\s*\\+\\s*", "_", name),".split_stage.KM_plot.pdf" )
    combined_plot <- plot_grid(result1$plot, result2$plot,result3$plot, result4$plot, ncol = 4)
    ggsave(combined_plot, file=file_name,device="pdf", width=16, height=4)
    
    output_file <- paste0(dirname, model_name,".","KM_results.split_stage.tsv")
    if (!file.exists(output_file)) {
      write.table(
        data.frame(
          model = character(),
          "Stage-I_KM_pvalue" = character(),
          "Stage-II_KM_pvalue" = character(),
          "Stage-III_KM_pvalue" = character(),
          "Stage-IV_KM_pvalue" = character()
        ),
        file = output_file, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)
    }
    
    write.table(output_df, file = output_file, sep = "\t", row.names = TRUE, col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, append = TRUE)
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Error in output_df:", e$message))
  })
}

## stage 2&3
KM_plot_fuc_stage_23 <- function(model_list, name, model_name,dirname,suffix="") {

  output_df <- data.frame()
  
  ###### stage 2&3
  tryCatch({
  tab_risk_cox_tmp <- model_list$tab_risk_cox %>%
    dplyr::filter(`TNM_Stage` %in% c(2, 3))
  result3 <- plot_km_fun(tab_4_kmplot = tab_risk_cox_tmp, title = paste0(name," Stage-II&III"), model_name = model_name, name=name,dirname=dirname,suffix="Stage-II&III")
  output_df[name, "Stage-II&III_KM_pvalue"] = result3$p_val
  risk_group <- result3$risk_group
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Error in Stage-II&III:", e$message))
  })
  
  tryCatch({
    ### combine plots
    file_name = paste0(dirname, model_name,".",gsub("\\s*\\+\\s*", "_", name),".split_stage.KM_plot.pdf" )
    combined_plot <- plot_grid(result3$plot, ncol = 1)
    ggsave(combined_plot, file=file_name,device="pdf", width=8, height=8)
    
    output_file <- paste0(dirname, model_name,".","KM_results.II&III.tsv")
    output_risk_file <- paste0(dirname, model_name,".",gsub("\\s*\\+\\s*", "_", name),".risk_group.II&III.tsv")
    if (!file.exists(output_file)) {
      write.table(
        data.frame(
          model = character(),
          "Stage-II&III_KM_pvalue" = character()
        ),
        file = output_file, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)
    }
    
    write.table(output_df, file = output_file, sep = "\t", row.names = TRUE, col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, append = TRUE)
    write.table(risk_group, file = output_risk_file, sep = "\t", row.names = TRUE, col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Error in output_df:", e$message))
  })
}
```

```{r}
Map(KM_plot_fuc_stage_split, prog_model_os, names(prog_model_os), model_name="sur_os",dirname="03.KM_plot.stage_split.pdf/")
```

```{r}
load(file="00.plot_input.Rdata")

### dfs plots

p_compare_dfs

### dfs heatmap

ht_input_dfs <- combine_input_dfs[rownames(combine_input_dfs) %in% c("dfs_Stage_I_KM_pvalue","dfs_Stage_II_KM_pvalue","dfs_Stage_III_KM_pvalue","dfs_Stage_IV_KM_pvalue"),]
rownames(ht_input_dfs) <- c("Stage I","Stage II","Stage III","Stage IV")


ht_input_dfs_out <- data.frame(t(ht_input_dfs),check.names=F)
write.table(ht_input_dfs_out, "03.KM_pvalues.DFS.tsv", row.names = T, quote=F,sep="\t")


add_stars <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return(0)
  
  p_val_threshold <- -log10(0.05)  

  n_stars <- 0
  if (p > p_val_threshold) n_stars <- 1
  if (p > 2)             n_stars <- 2
  if (p > 3)             n_stars <- 3
  if (p > 4)             n_stars <- 4
  
  return(n_stars) 
}

### add stars### add stars
star_matrix_dfs <- matrix(nrow = nrow(ht_input_dfs), ncol = ncol(ht_input_dfs))
for (i in 1:nrow(ht_input_dfs)) {
  for (j in 1:ncol(ht_input_dfs)) {
    star_matrix_dfs[i, j] <- add_stars(ht_input_dfs[i, j])
  }
}
rownames(star_matrix_dfs) <- rownames(ht_input_dfs)
colnames(star_matrix_dfs) <- colnames(ht_input_dfs)
### color palette
my_palette = colorRampPalette(c("white","#D73120"))(100)
n_rows <- nrow(ht_input_dfs)

### heatmap
heatmap_dfs <- Heatmap(ht_input_dfs, 
                   col = my_palette, 
                   cluster_columns = FALSE, 
                   cluster_rows = FALSE,
                   column_order = names(mean_cindex_dfs),
                   cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
                      n_stars = star_matrix_dfs[i, j]
                      if (n_stars > 0) {
                        star_pacing <- 0.15
                        star_size <- 0.8
                        total_stack_len <- (n_stars - 1) * star_pacing * height
                        start_y <- y - total_stack_len/2
                        for (k in 1:n_stars) {
                          star_y <- start_y + (k - 1) * star_pacing * height
                          grid.text("*", x=x, y=star_y,
                                    gp = gpar(fontsize=8*star_size,
                                              col = "black"))
                        }
                      }
                   },
                   na_col = "grey95",
                   heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "-log10(p)"),
                   row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),  
                    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6), 
                    height = unit(2.5, "cm") )

ht_grob <- grid.grabExpr(draw(heatmap_dfs, heatmap_legend_side = "right"))
blank_plot <- ggplot() + theme_void() 

final_plot <- grid.arrange(
  arrangeGrob(p_compare_dfs, blank_plot, ncol = 2, widths = c(85, 15)),
  # arrangeGrob(p_bar, blank_plot,ncol = 2, widths=c(96,4)),
  arrangeGrob(blank_plot, ht_grob,  ncol = 2, widths = c(6, 94)),
  nrow = 2,
  heights = c(2,8) 
)

final_ggplot <- as_ggplot(final_plot)  
final_ggplot
ggsave("dfs.lambda_min.c_index_htmap.pdf", final_ggplot, width = 8, height = 7,limitsize = FALSE)
```

```{r}
### add stars function
add_stars <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("")  
  if (p > 4) return("*\n*\n*\n*")
  if (p > 3) return("*\n*\n*")
  if (p > 2) return("*\n*")
  if (p > -log10(0.05)) return("*")
  return("")  
}
```
